bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed in the venue. All bags will be searched prior to entry, and non-clear bags will undergo additional search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The Wiltern offers premium underground parking and upgrades for select shows. The most convenient parking option is the Ralphs parking structure adjacent to the venue, accessible from Oxford Street through the north entrance.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The Wiltern's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Wiltern offers a variety of concession items including popcorn, chips, pizza, churros, and nachos, along with alcoholic and nonalcoholic beverages. The venue is cashless, accepting major credit cards and ApplePay.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Wiltern's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The Wiltern. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The accessible restroom is located on the main level to the right of the main entrance as you enter.
